theorem: For each of the TWO explicit nonnegative diagonal 4x4 grid cones R3 and R4 below, EVERY PPT operator in that cone is a positive sum of complex Schmidt-rank<=2 projectors. This holds for ALL nonnegative weights, including zero and singular boundaries. These are proper cones; the theorem is not about all 4x4 PPT operators.
notation: For [x]=|x><x|, define A=|00>+|11>+|22>, B=|01>+|12>, D=|10>-|21>, C=|02>+|33>, E=|20>+|33>. All kets here live in C^4 tensor C^4, with Bob labels reindexed after a coordinate compression.
cone_R3: R3=alpha[A]+beta[B]+delta[D]+gamma[C]+epsilon[20]+eta[30]+iota[32]+kappa[03], with all eight real coefficients nonnegative. It is the Bob-column-3-deleted diagonal source-range cone.
cone_R4: R4=alpha[A]+beta[B]+delta[D]+gamma[02]+epsilon[E]+phi[23]+eta[30]+iota[32], with all eight real coefficients nonnegative. It is the Bob-column-4-deleted diagonal source-range cone.
shared_ppt_inequality: For both cones, the partial transpose principal submatrix on |01>,|10> is [[beta,alpha],[alpha,delta]], so PPT implies beta*delta>=alpha^2. For R3 the principal submatrix on |11>,|20> is [[alpha,-delta],[-delta,epsilon]], so alpha*epsilon>=delta^2. For R4 the principal submatrix on |02>,|11> is [[gamma,beta],[beta,alpha]], so alpha*gamma>=beta^2. These are exact necessary PSD conditions, not asserted sufficient for PPT.
boundary_alpha_zero: If alpha=0, A is absent and every other defining vector has Schmidt rank at most2, so the defining nonnegative sum itself proves SN<=2. No division or extra PPT assumption is needed.
R3_uniform_decomposition: If alpha>0, PPT forces beta,delta>0. Combining beta*delta>=alpha^2 and alpha*epsilon>=delta^2 gives epsilon>=delta^2/alpha>=alpha^3/beta^2. For each z^4=1 define q_z=z*sqrt(alpha)*A+sqrt(beta)*B+z^2*sqrt(delta)*D-z^3*(alpha^(3/2)/beta)|20>. Its only nonzero 3x3 block has determinant a^3+b^2 e=0 because c=0, hence SR(q_z)<=2. Root-phase orthogonality gives (1/4)sum_z[q_z]=alpha[A]+beta[B]+delta[D]+(alpha^3/beta^2)[20]. Subtract this from R3; all residual coefficients are nonnegative and every residual vector has Schmidt rank <=2.
R4_uniform_decomposition: If alpha>0, the same beta*delta bound and alpha*gamma>=beta^2 give gamma>=beta^2/alpha>=alpha^3/delta^2. For each z^4=1 define q'_z=z*sqrt(alpha)*A+z^2*sqrt(beta)*B+sqrt(delta)*D+z^3*(alpha^(3/2)/delta)|02>. Its only nonzero 3x3 block has determinant a^3-d^2 c=0 because e=0, so SR(q'_z)<=2. Root-phase orthogonality yields (1/4)sum_z[q'_z]=alpha[A]+beta[B]+delta[D]+(alpha^3/delta^2)[02]. All remaining terms of R4 have nonnegative coefficients and Schmidt rank <=2.
other_coordinate_cuts: For the same nine source grid generators with arbitrary nonnegative diagonal weights, deleting Bob column 0,1 or2 directly makes A have Schmidt rank <=2; every other generator already has rank <=2. Thus all five coordinate compressions of every such diagonal source operator are SR<=2 whenever the compressed operator is PPT (for the first three, PPT is not even needed). This does not assert the pre-compression operator was PPT.

exact_checks.observed: Two independent exact rational weighted examples, one in each cone: each had state rank8, PT rank12 with nonnegative Fraction Schur pivots, four phase vectors with all sixteen 3x3 rank minors zero, and all 256 state entries matched. For R3 weights (alpha,beta,delta,gamma,epsilon,eta,iota,kappa)=(1,4,1,25,4,3,25,25); for R4 (alpha,beta,delta,gamma,epsilon,phi,eta,iota)=(1,1,4,4,25,25,25,3).
exact_checks.debugging: The first local run rejected a zero-weight rank-three generator because the checker unnecessarily tested its rank even when its weight was zero. The checker was fixed to skip zero-weight terms and the complete stated rerun passed. The earlier run is not treated as a pass.

limits: This is a coefficient-diagonal proper subcone with two specified support patterns and, separately, their other coordinate cuts. It is not an all-state 4x4 result, not an arbitrary-kernel projection theorem, and does not provide an SN>=3 witness. The actual source PPT/SN3 state was from the previously cited arXiv:2509.07086v1 range; novelty, priority, formal/kernel and independent human review are not claimed.
